title: Time Taken to Cross the Door
exampleStatus: Source examples not copied; worked illustrations are independently authored in clarification.
summary: state=0 means entering and 1 exiting. Crossing takes one second. When both directions wait, reuse the previous second's direction; after an idle second prefer exiting. Within one direction, smallest person index goes first. If only one direction waits, serve it. Return each person's crossing start time.
clarification: The questioned draft is correct: arrival=[0,1,1], state=[0,1,0] gives [0,2,1]. Person 0 enters at t=0; person 2 enters at t=1 because entering was used at t=0; person 1 exits at t=2. This is a worked draft case, not a claim that it is an official sample.
constraintsReportedBySource: 1<=n<=100000; arrival and state length n; arrival sorted, values 0..n; state binary.
verificationStatus: community-reproduction-read; official text not independently confirmed
